thread:
Sam R: Heads-up: aiming to publish release announcement next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog + docs links by EOD today so social and press can be queued.
Priya E: Changelog draft at https://redwood.ai/changelog/v1.4-preview. Key bullets: streaming latency improvements, prefix caching, Dedicated capacity toggles.
Sam R: Can you paste the short marketing blurb we should use for legal?
Priya E: Suggested: 'Redwood Inference v1.4: lower-latency streaming and smarter caching to speed interactive apps.' We'll add "preliminary internal benchmarks" note.
Leo V: Docs PR: https://redwood.ai/docs/v1.4-preview (screenshots behind feature-flag in eu regions). Also added a small FAQ about Dedicated pricing.
Deploy Bot: Canary rollout scheduled Tue 02:15 PT -> canary-us-west-1; smoke tests 20m; notify: #eng-oncall. Job id: 334455.
Maya K: Webinar planned Thu 10am PT. Speakers: Maya (product), Leo (tech). Leads from webinar should post to https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-v1-4 with fields: name,email,company,interest_level,company_size,utm_campaign.
Sam R: Rollback owner? Need single person during launch window.
Leo V: I'll own rollback and updated runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-v1.4. Steps: revert to v1.3, run smoke, verify p95 and error-rate.
Priya E: Marketing will tag CRM as "launch_v1_4" and set owner to inbound SDRs. We'll label latency numbers "preliminary internal benchmarks" and link bench: https://bench.redwood.ai/run/8910.
Sam R: Great. If changelog/docs not live by 16:00 PT we hold the post and notify this thread. Final copy to be posted here by 4pm PT for legal micro-review. :white_check_mark:
